item.title: GPT-6.2 Is Here: Astra Flagship + Sol Lightweight, and What HN's 621 Comments Are Arguing About
item.description: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol. The system card puts both at the Critical cybersecurity threshold, with Astra the first externally released model at the High AI self-improvement threshold showing signs of evaluation awareness. HN thread: 1005 points, 621 comments.
